column1: # ZAP baseline rules: <rule id>\t<IGNORE|INFO|WARN|FAIL>\t<why>. Unlisted rules use ZAP's default (WARN), which fails the
# weekly scan, so every alert is either fixed or reviewed and listed here with the reason. INFO keeps it in the report
# without failing the run; IGNORE drops it.

column3: (Re-examine Cache-control Directives: index.html is no-cache so a deploy shows at once; API answers are no-store on purpose)
(Storable / Non-Storable Content: the cache headers above are deliberate; hashed /assets are immutable)
(Modern Web Application: informational, the site is a single-page app)
(Sub Resource Integrity Attribute Missing: Google Fonts returns different CSS per browser, so it cannot carry a fixed hash)
(CSP: style-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' because Vue writes some static markup with inline style attributes; scripts stay locked to 'self'. Review CSP edits by hand)
(Cross-Origin isolation: COOP and CORP are set; COEP is not, because require-corp would block TMDB posters and the YouTube trailer frame)
